cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from test_perf import build_big
prof, fab = build_big()
plan = json.loads(__import__('subprocess').run(
    [sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],
    input=json.dumps({"op":"plan","profile":prof,"fabric":fab})+'\n',
    capture_output=True).stdout)
# same fabric twice (plan + audit) -> cache hits on 2nd
with open('big_both.jsonl','w') as f:
    f.write(json.dumps({"op":"plan","profile":prof,"fabric":fab})+'\n')
    f.write(json.dumps({"op":"audit","profile":prof,"fabric":fab,"proposal":plan})+'\n')
# two different fabrics (adversarial)
prof2, fab2 = build_big(2)
with open('big_diff.jsonl','w') as f:
    f.write(json.dumps({"op":"plan","profile":prof,"fabric":fab})+'\n')
    f.write(json.dumps({"op":"plan","profile":prof2,"fabric":fab2})+'\n')
print('written')
EOF
cd /workspace/tmp && time (timeout 170 python3 -B /workspace/submission/main.py < big_both.jsonl > big_out2.json; echo exit=$?)
